messages.author: dda031474bc063da
messages.subject: No. of background points
parts:
Hi Jamie! I was just wondering how can we tell wallace in module 4 that we want to use as many points as we can for background sample.... I am trying to do this since I have truncated response curves for certain species and I saw that it could be better to characterize all the extent rather than use 10,000 points.... 

Thanks! 
Oscar

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: No. of background points
parts:
Oscar,

You can just set an arbitrarily high number of background points, and it will revert to the maximum number of grid cells in your background extent.

Jamie
